violations.why: After the task reads v_garnet==1 at 41 and enables the ISR at 43, the ISR can set it to 0. The task then reads the changed value at 49.
The ISR is enabled between the reads at 38 and 44 (during idlerun and before disable_isr). It can write v_willow in that window.
The ISR is enabled at 43 and again at 51, and it can run between the reads at 44 and 52. It can write v_willow in that window.
